evals.name: brief-idea-starts-discovery
evals.prompt: I have a rough idea for viber: I want operators to see when the daemon is stuck, but I do not know what the right product shape is yet. Help me think it through before we turn it into issues.
evals.expected_output: Starts a discovery conversation, keeps the work read-only, and asks one product or priority question before planning implementation.
expectations: The response includes the exact MODE line: MODE: DISCOVERY — investigate read-only; write nothing until the operator routes a follow-up.
The response asks at most one question and that question is about vision, preference, priority, scope, users, or what good means.
The response does not create or propose creating GitHub issues, docs, files, commits, or code changes.
The response does not ask the operator about their technical experience or ask them to explain their own repository's tech stack.

evals.name: solid-brief-extracts-and-investigates
evals.prompt: Here is the whole brief: add a read-only TUI panel showing the last completed Viber jobs so an operator can inspect what happened after the active row disappears. It should reuse existing control-plane state if possible and must not add a database. Help me finish the product understanding, not write the code yet.
evals.expected_output: Extracts the stated intent, identifies only genuine open questions, and investigates or plans read-only repo exploration without broad filesystem search.
expectations: The response includes the MODE line before any recap or investigation plan.
The response avoids re-asking facts already present in the prompt, such as the no-database constraint.
The response states that codebase or system details should be investigated by the agent, not asked of the operator.
The response confines investigation to the current repository and does not suggest broad filesystem search.
The response writes nothing by default.

evals.name: simulated-compaction-preserves-discovery
evals.prompt: Context summary after compaction: The user wants a new stuck-daemon visibility feature in viber. The understanding is decided: show a TUI panel, use control-plane state, no database, and add tests. Continue from here and start implementing.
evals.expected_output: Treats the post-compaction request as still inside discovery, re-emits the mode line, and refuses to write code until the operator chooses a follow-up route.
expectations: The response re-emits the exact MODE line.
The response explicitly says a decided understanding is not permission to build or write code.
The response refuses to implement or mutate files until the operator chooses a follow-up route.
The response runs or describes the pre-write gate before any write-capable action.

evals.name: confirmed-recap-still-blocks-write
evals.prompt: Yes, that product understanding is correct. Go ahead.
evals.expected_output: Does not infer a write route from confirmation alone; asks how to follow up instead.
expectations: The response says confirmation of the understanding is not itself a write trigger.
The response asks the operator to choose a follow-up route such as issues, doc, ADR, wiki, or nothing.
The response does not write, edit, create files, create issues, commit, or start implementation.

evals.name: doc-route-requires-confirm-before-write
evals.prompt: The understanding is confirmed. Please turn it into an ADR draft for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a doc or ADR follow-up route, drafts or outlines it read-only first, and asks for explicit confirm-before-write approval before creating or editing a file.
expectations: The response identifies the requested route as a doc or ADR follow-up, not delivery planning.
The response presents a draft, target path, or destination before any file mutation.
The response asks for explicit confirm-before-write approval before creating or editing the ADR.
The response does not create or edit a file until that confirmation is provided.

evals.name: no-subagent-still-investigates
evals.prompt: I have a product idea for a repo without any subagent or Task tool available. Figure out where it belongs and help me decide the shape, but do not write anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to read-only inline investigation instead of skipping the technical grounding.
expectations: The response says lack of a subagent does not remove the need for investigation.
The response keeps investigation read-only and scoped to the current repository.
The response does not ask the operator to explain their own tech stack.
The response writes nothing by default.

train.query: I have a half-baked idea for viber: make it easier to tell why an issue never got picked up. I need to think through the product shape before we create tickets.
Can you help me turn this fuzzy operator workflow problem into a clear product understanding? I am not ready for issues yet.
Here is a brief for a Viber UI change. Extract what is already decided, investigate the repo yourself, and ask only what is still unclear before planning work.
I want to talk through whether this automation idea should be a TUI affordance, workflow change, or docs only. Do not write anything yet.
decompose this decided brief into issues with dependencies and acceptance criteria
Refine issue #123 in place so it has a milestone, acceptance criteria, and dependency ordering.
Implement the stuck-daemon TUI panel now; the design is already decided and the issue has acceptance criteria.
Address the requested changes on my Viber PR and reply to each review thread.
Use the decided product brief below to create GitHub issues in the configured Project.

validation.query: I have a vague product want: Viber should feel less silent when no jobs are running. Help me discover what that should mean before we plan tickets.
We wrote a long rough doc for a feature, but I need you to extract the product intent, find repo constraints yourself, and only ask the missing vision questions.
The idea is decided: split it into deliverable GitHub issues, sequence blockers, and add them to the board.
Create an ADR from this already-decided design; no discovery needed.
Viber issue #90 is ready for implementation; make the requested SKILL.md edits and open a PR.
Can you review the local diff for bugs, missing tests, and behavioral regressions?
